title: ERIT: A Responsible Multimodal Affective Computing Benchmark for Older-Adult Emotion Recognition in the Wild
abstract: arXiv:2407.17772v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We introduce a controlled evaluation setting for image-text fusion in older adult emotion recognition, instantiated in the ERIT benchmark. Many existing video-based emotion datasets rely on frame sampling during evaluation, and differences in how frames are sampled can substantially affect results - yet such details are seldom disclosed, limiting reproducibility and fair comparison. ERIT removes this source of variability by pairing representative annotated frames with corresponding transcribed speech, so that each sample has fixed visual and textual inputs. The dataset covers seven emotions (anger, disgust, fear, happiness, sadness, surprise, and neutral), and is designed primarily as a controlled evaluation resource for the underrepresented population of older adults. translated_title: ERIT：一个面向老年人真实场景情感识别的负责任多模态情感计算基准
translated_abstract: 我们介绍了一个用于老年人情感识别中图文融合的受控评估设置，并在ERIT基准中予以实现。许多现有的基于视频的情感数据集在评估时依赖帧采样，而帧采样方式的差异可能会显著影响结果——然而此类细节很少被披露，限制了可重复性和公平比较。ERIT通过将代表性的标注帧与相应的转录语音配对，消除了这一变异来源，使每个样本具有固定的视觉和文本输入。该数据集涵盖七种情绪（愤怒、厌恶、恐惧、快乐、悲伤、惊讶和中性），主要设计为针对老年人这一代表性不足群体的受控评估资源。我们在零样本设置下使用LLaVA-NeXT、Qwen2-VL、GPT-4V和GPT-4o对ERIT进行评估，并使用LoRA对LLaVA-NeXT进行微调，比较不同评估标准下的结果。
tldr: ERIT基准通过将代表性标注帧与转录语音配对以固定多模态输入，消除了帧采样带来的变异性，为老年人这一代表性不足群体的真实场景情感识别提供了可重复、可公平比较的受控图文融合评估基准。
